Interactive .rsip & .rsis Section Filter

Core .rsip Project, .rsis Suite & .rsii Include Sections
Section / Directive File Type Key Fields & Purpose
@include "file.rsii" .rsip / .rsii Inherits shared [Requirements], [Signing], or publisher defaults without losing comments on IDE save.
[Package] .rsip (Required) Name, Version (3-part Major.Minor.Build), Manufacturer, UpgradeCode, Architecture (x64|arm64), Scope (machine|user), PackageKind (msi|msm).
[Install] .rsip (Required) DefaultSubdir (under ProgramFiles64Folder or LocalAppDataFolder), StartMenuFolder, MainExecutable.
[UI] .rsip (Optional) WizardLayout (standard|autorun16x9), AccentPrimaryHex, LicenseRtf, IconFile, ArtworkPng, InstallButtonText (with & mnemonic).
[Payload.<Id>] .rsip (1+ Required) Source (supports $(ARCH)), TargetSubdir, Recursive, Feature — compressed into #payload.cab with deterministic UUIDv5 GUIDs.
[Signing] .rsip / .rsii Enabled, Thumbprint, TimestampUrl, DlibPath, MetadataJson — signs inner .msi first, then outer Setup.exe.
[Suite] & [Project.<Id>] .rsis Suite Groups multiple .rsip projects with [Variable] tokens, Category tags, and ascending BuildOrder (e.g., .msm = 10 → .msi = 20).

GitHub Actions & Microsoft Intune Quickstart

name: Package Windows x64 & ARM64 Installers
on: [push]
jobs:
  package:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Lint .rsis Suite (Sub-Millisecond JSON Diagnostics)
        run: .indinstbuild.exe .AcmeSuite.rsis --validate --diagnostics=json
      - name: Compile Enterprise .MSI, Setup.exe & VPAT 2.5 ACR
        run: .indinstbuild.exe .AcmeSuite.rsis --with-vpat
instbuild.exe & SetupWizard.exe Standard Exit Codes
Exit Code Meaning CI/CD or Intune Action
0 ERROR_SUCCESS — Validation, compilation, or silent install succeeded Promote .msi, -setup.exe, and VPAT 2.5 report to release artifacts.
1 Schema validation error, missing payload file, or post-build ICE80 check failure Parse --diagnostics=json line numbers in CI logs.
2 Invalid command-line arguments or missing input path Verify CLI syntax against instbuild.exe --help.
3010 ERROR_SUCCESS_REBOOT_REQUIRED (Runtime SetupWizard.exe /qn) Standard Windows Installer soft-reboot return code recognized natively by Microsoft Intune & SCCM.
